approach: Keep the single-switch design. One gate-side helper `attribution::after_cutover` decides "after C0". Writers (build_commit_in, commit_with_staged) strip Athena- trailers when it holds. gate() skips invariant::check when it holds, so the real commit-msg hook accepts trailer-free commits. Post-C0, landed_commit finds the job's commit through its verification record. run.rs retry_landing skips the trailer search after C0 and does not re-emit trailers. Squash uses a new relaxed text form. trace and the auditor fall back to C0..head. Pre-C0 paths stay byte-for-byte. A lifecycle test with a valid pre-C0 history proves it end to end.

decisions.choice: attribution::after_cutover(git, parent, &config) -> Result<Option<String>> returns c0 only when the parent's config has cutover_job, cutover_state is Shown and c0 is an ancestor of parent. gate() skips invariant::check (CommitMsg, Commit, CommitLegacyUsage) via a Judged.after_c0 field. Doc comment states: the Shown state comes from the records-branch tip (as check_history uses it); only the config and ancestor check are tied to the parent.
decisions.reason: One decision point shared by the hook, plumbing commits and check_history, so no commit exists that no rule can judge.

rejected.why: The installed hook still runs invariant::check and would refuse trailer-free commits.

rejected.option: Strip once the landing record exists (Pending)
rejected.why: check_history still applies trailer rules until the manifest shows the cutover.

decisions.choice: run.rs retry_landing: when after_cutover holds for the candidate base/head, skip the log_grep trailer search entirely, build the landing trailers as only Co-Authored-By (no Athena-* keys, since build_commit strips them anyway), and set Finished.prediction_commit to None. Pre-C0 branch unchanged. Add run.rs to Files. The 'closing commit not found' bail stays only on the pre-C0 path.
decisions.reason: The search at run.rs:2524-2536 finds the blocked job's closing commit by Athena-Job to copy Prediction/Class/etc. trailers. After C0 nothing is re-emitted, so nothing needs to be found; the verification-record lookup is not used here. Fields live in the job records if ever needed.

rejected.option: Replace the search with the verification-record lookup
rejected.why: That lookup finds a landing commit, not the blocked closing commit, and supplies no trailer values.
Resuming a blocked post-C0 job would always fail with 'closing commit not found'.

decisions.choice: Post-C0 landed_commit (gh.rs) returns the newest commit in c0..head that adds the job's verification record file and whose record fingerprint equals the verified fingerprint; pre-C0 path unchanged. Producer confirms the record path and fingerprint field from athena-data records layout before writing the log path filter.

demonstrations.method: lifecycle.rs scratch repo: bootstrap commit, old-way job landed with trailers, cutover job as C0 (landing record + manifest), hooks installed. One branch: commit_with_staged intervention, Committer records-only commit, job landing commit; land_pr with squash. Read messages via git.message.
demonstrations.observes: The squash commit and each of the three PR commits (via the landing record's second parent) have no line starting with 'Athena-'; land_pr found the landed commit.
demonstrations.fails_without: A writer emitting trailers leaves Athena- lines; a hook requiring trailers refuses the intervention; a trailer-based landed_commit stops land_pr with 'job is not landed'.

demonstrations.method: Same test: assert check_history and check_attribution violations are empty on the pre-C0 base first, then read the landing record and assert the kinds, then assert both empty on the post-C0 base. No assertion that violations exist.
demonstrations.observes: Kinds declared_intervention, records_only, job_landing; both reports empty.
demonstrations.fails_without: Wrong classification or violations reported if attribution or the gate skip were missing.

demonstrations.method: athena-git unit tests for strict form (exactly one Athena-Job; zero or two refused) and relaxed form (no Athena- line); gh.rs test builds the post-C0 PR request and checks commit_message.
demonstrations.observes: Strict unchanged; relaxed emits no Athena- line; post-C0 landing uses relaxed.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the relaxed form a trailer-free post-C0 message is refused; a changed strict form accepts zero/two Athena-Job.

demonstrations.method: Committer::commit_records in scratch repos: Shown with c0 ancestor; no cutover_job; cutover_job but no landing record; Pending.
demonstrations.observes: No Athena- line after C0 and the gate accepts it; trailers still written in the three kept cases; existing tests unchanged.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the strip the after-C0 message keeps trailers; without the guard kept cases lose them.

demonstrations.method: status.rs test calls Athena::trace on a scratch repo with a job landed up to C0 (trailers) and one after (trailer-free); auditor.rs test drives the public auditor run on both jobs; run.rs test resumes a blocked post-C0 job via retry_landing and lands it.
demonstrations.observes: Pre-C0 job gives same commits/files as before; post-C0 job gives its commits/files from C0..head; blocked post-C0 job lands without the trailer search.
demonstrations.fails_without: No fallback: post-C0 trace lists no commits, auditor errors 'none could be read', retry_landing bails 'closing commit not found'.

demonstrations.method: history.rs test: trailer-free post-C0 commit gives no Rule::Invariant, planted secret still reported. lib.rs gate tests in CommitMsg and Commit scopes after C0: trailer-free commit passes; content violation still reported; a bad job record still reported by jobs::check; pre-C0 trailer-free commit still reports Rule::Invariant.
demonstrations.observes: Only invariant::check is dropped; content and jobs checks stay in gate; check_history after C0 runs secrets, attribution (plus records-file checks).
demonstrations.fails_without: If invariant::check still ran, the trailer-free commit reports Rule::Invariant; if content or jobs were dropped the bad record passes.
